snippet.title: Gearbits: Nintendo Switch Edition
snippet.description:
Gearbits is a 3D action game with a nostalgic retro aesthetic. Pilot a giant mech, fight massive swarms of vicious giant insects and face off against enemy pilots! 

Featuring a rich single player campaign, wave mode missions and lots of unlockables, Gearbits is a love-letter to the mecha genre!

Gearbits: Nintendo Switch™ edition includes all expansion content added to the original game.

https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Gearbits-2918523.html
